items.raw_excerpt: Hinchada del United recordará con una pancarta que Manchester City
items.summary_en: Manchester United fans plan to show a banner at the stadium. The banner says Manchester City won nothing fairly. It is a playful jab between the two rival clubs.
items.summary_ko: 맨체스터 유나이티드 팬들이 경기장에서 현수막을 들 계획이다. 현수막에는 맨체스터 시티가 떳떳하게 우승한 게 없다는 내용이 담긴다. 두 라이벌 구단 사이의 장난 섞인 신경전이다.
items.title_en: United fans will hold up a banner saying Man City won nothing clean

items.raw_excerpt: This comes as investigations continue into a turbine trip at Unit One.
items.summary_en: A nuclear power station in South Africa let reporters inside for a look. It was the first media tour there in 40 years. The visit came as workers look into a turbine shutdown at Unit One.

items.raw_excerpt: A Department of Conservation scientist is urging boaties to watch out for flesh-footed shearwaters, toanui, as they return to Aotearoa after several months near Japan.
items.summary_en: A scientist from New Zealand's Department of Conservation is asking boaties to look out for flesh-footed shearwaters. The birds, also called toanui, are flying back to Aotearoa after spending months near Japan. Fishers are asked to take care around the returning seabirds.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 보존부 과학자가 뱃사람들에게 살깃발바닷새를 주의 깊게 살펴봐 달라고 부탁했어요. 토아누이로도 불리는 이 새들은 일본 근처에서 몇 달을 보낸 뒤 뉴질랜드로 돌아오고 있어요. 어민들은 돌아오는 바닷새를 잘 살펴봐야 해요.
items.title_en: Scientist asks fishers to watch for returning seabirds
items.title_ko: 과학자, 돌아오는 바닷새를 지켜봐 달라고 어민에게 부탁
items.title_original: Scientist issues plea for fishers to watch out for seabirds returning from migration

items.summary_en: A farm tourism trip in Hualien takes visitors to Luoshan Organic Village and the Zhiluo tribe in the East Rift Valley. Guests join guided tours, try hands-on farm activities, and taste local dishes. The quiet valley trip blends rice fields, coffee, and plum crops with a relaxed country mood.
items.summary_ko: 대만 화롄의 농촌 체험 여행이 뤄산 유기농 마을과 즈뤄 부족 마을을 찾는다. 방문객은 해설을 듣고 농사 체험을 하며 지역 음식도 맛본다. 벼와 커피, 매실이 자라는 동부 골짜기의 한적한 풍경이 여유로운 시골 분위기를 전한다.

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmania's EPA is worried about the extent of AI data centre company Firmus's planned diesel generator use, saying it is much more than initially disclosed.
items.summary_en: An AI data centre company called Firmus wants to run diesel generators in Tasmania. The state's EPA says the company did not tell it how many generators it planned to use. The EPA is worried the number is much larger than first thought.
items.summary_ko: 인공지능 데이터센터 회사 피르무스가 태즈메이니아에서 디젤 발전기를 돌리려 한다. 주 환경청은 회사가 발전기를 몇 대나 쓸 계획인지 미리 알려주지 않았다고 말했다. 환경청은 처음 알려진 것보다 규모가 훨씬 클까 봐 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: Tasmania's EPA says it was not told how many diesel generators a data centre planned to use
items.title_ko: 태즈메이니아 환경청, 데이터센터의 디젤 발전기 규모를 미리 듣지 못했다고 밝혀
items.title_original: Tasmanian EPA says it was not told extent of Firmus data centre generator plans

items.raw_excerpt: Unseasonal wet and cool conditions in the state's far north are expected to continue throughout Spring, as the rest of the state battles with dry conditions.
items.summary_en: Most of Queensland is having a hot, dry spring. But the far north is seeing wet and cool weather that is not normal for this season. Forecasters expect the wet pattern there to last through spring.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드 대부분 지역이 덥고 건조한 봄을 보내고 있다. 반면 주 북부는 이맘때답지 않게 비가 잦고 쌀쌀한 날씨가 이어지고 있다. 기상당국은 북부의 이런 비 날씨가 봄 내내 계속될 것으로 내다봤다.
items.title_en: Queensland has a dry spring, but the far north stays wet
items.title_ko: 퀸즐랜드 대부분은 건조한 봄, 북부는 비 계속
items.title_original: Queensland battles dry spring except in far north

items.summary_en: A village green in Yorkshire has no owner. Local people have looked after it for 60 years. It now has protected status.

items.title_en: Village green protected after locals care for it 60 years

items.raw_excerpt: El joven canterano de 18 años aseguró su vínculo tras sus buenas presentaciones en Copa Chile.
items.summary_en: An 18-year-old academy player named Gedeon Diaz has signed his first professional contract. Colo Colo gave him the deal after his strong games in the Copa Chile.

items.raw_excerpt: Questions have been raised over Darwin City Council leading a delegation of businesses to China and Vietnam later this year, on a trip that will cost local ratepayers thousands of dollars.
items.summary_en: Darwin City Council is sending a business group to China and Vietnam later this year. The trip will cost local ratepayers thousands of dollars. Some residents question the spending during a cost-of-living crisis.
items.summary_ko: 다윈 시의회가 올해 말 기업 대표단을 중국과 베트남으로 보낸다. 이 출장에는 지역 납세자들의 돈이 수천 달러 들어간다. 생활비 위기 속에 일부 주민들은 이 지출을 두고 의문을 제기한다.

items.summary_en: A new hotel is getting ready to open in the centre of Portimao. It will bring new life to a building that was empty for several years.

items.summary_en: On October 10, 2026, the city of Lyon holds its annual Pride march. A colorful parade and a community village await visitors at Parc de la Tete d'Or. The event runs from 11:30 to 19:00.

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland Transport is apologising after a woman was separated from her four-year-old daughter when a bus driver closed the door before she could board with her mobility dog.
items.summary_en: A bus driver in Auckland closed the door before a woman could get on with her mobility dog. Her four-year-old daughter was already on the bus. Auckland Transport has apologised for what happened.

items.title_en: Bus driver leaves mother behind but lets daughter board
